Welcome to Dex Hub TV

Dex Hub TV uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb terms.
Dex Hub TV uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.
Dex Hub TV uses MDBList for ratings, watched history and playback tracking. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
Dex Hub TV connects to your own Jellyfin, Emby, Silo or Plex server. Their names and logos belong to their owners. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by Jellyfin, Emby or Silo.
Dex Hub TV connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.

Dex Hub TV connects to Simkl for account authentication, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, and scrobbling. Movie, TV, and anime tracking data is provided by Simkl. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.

Dex Hub TV is a media player. It comes with no films, shows, channels or streams and doesn\'t host, provide or link to any. Everything you play comes from a source you chose to connect: your own media server, an account you hold with another service, or an add-on or extension you installed. Those are made and run by other people, and Dex Hub TV doesn\'t control, check or endorse them. You are responsible for making sure you have the right to play what you play and that your use follows the law where you live.
Data providers, service credits, and Android playback licenses used by Dex Hub TV.

Dex Hub TV uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Dex Hub TV connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
Dex Hub TV connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.
Dex Hub TV uses WeTrakr for watched history, lists, playback tracking and similar titles. Data from WeTrakr. Dex Hub TV is not affiliated with or endorsed by WeTrakr.

This stream uses peer-to-peer (P2P) technology. By enabling P2P, you acknowledge and agree that:

• Your IP address will be visible to other peers in the network
• You are solely responsible for the content you access
• You confirm you have the legal right to stream this content in your jurisdiction
• Dex Hub TV does not host, distribute, or control any P2P content
• Dex Hub TV bears no liability for any legal consequences arising from your use of P2P streaming

You use this feature entirely at your own risk. P2P can be disabled anytime in Settings.

Show Plex\'s own rows from this server (Recently Added and more) on Dex Hub TV\'s Home.
Plex won\'t play this away from home. In apps like Dex Hub TV that needs Plex Pass on the server, or a Remote Watch Pass for you. At home it plays free.
No server address needed: Dex Hub TV finds your Plex servers after you sign in.
Your Plex account has Plex Home users. Dex Hub TV uses the one you pick for progress, watched marks and Continue Watching on %1$s. You can change it later on the server\'s page.

If this is your own server and you expect this, you can trust this certificate. Dex Hub TV will then accept only this exact certificate for this server and will warn you if it ever changes. If you are not on your home network, check the fingerprint with the server\'s owner first.

Choose the name Dex Hub TV shows for this server. Leave it empty to use the server\'s own name.
Dex Hub TV couldn\'t find this Silo server\'s Jellyfin address. In Silo, open Settings > Connect Apps > Jellyfin-compatible app and enter the address shown under Server.
Show the rows from your Silo Home (your lists, Trending, Next up…) on Dex Hub TV\'s Home.
Uses Silo\'s address for Jellyfin apps, with a username and password (name#Profile for a profile). The way Dex Hub TV connected to Silo so far.
%1$s has more than one profile. Dex Hub TV uses the one you pick for progress, watched marks and Home rows. You can change it later on the server\'s page.
Dex Hub TV automatically checks Simkl at most once every %1$d minutes. Changes made through another app or the Simkl website may take that long to appear.
Changes made in Dex Hub TV are sent to Simkl immediately. Use Sync now whenever you want Dex Hub TV to check for remote changes sooner.
Everything in Dex Hub TV works without a membership
Your membership couldn’t be checked right now. Everything in Dex Hub TV works without one. If you want to help the Nuvio team, a membership adds a few extras:
Dex Hub TV is built on the official Nuvio app. A membership goes to the Nuvio team, helps pay for servers and development, and keeps the core app free for everyone.
Your perks follow your Nuvio account, so they work here in Dex Hub TV and in the official app.
